in_sanskrit.name: तारांगा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is the embodiment of stars and the cosmos. Radiant and beautiful.

in_hindi.name: तारांगा
in_hindi.long_meaning: A name that signifies the embodiment of stars and the one who sings the song of the cosmos.

in_tamil.name: தாராங்கா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who shines like a star in the sky and brings radiance and beauty to life.

in_telugu.name: తారాఙ్గా
in_telugu.long_meaning: A name that represents the embodiment of stars and the cosmos, signifying one who is radiant and beautiful.

in_marathi.name: Taraangaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Taraangaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Taranga’, which means ‘star’ or ‘radiant’. Taraangaa is a popular Hindu name for girls, believed to bring good luck and prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Taraangaa
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Star, Radiant
in_bengali.long_meaning: Taraangaa একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Taranga’, which means ‘star’ or ‘radiant’. Taraangaa is a popular Hindu name for girls, believed to bring good luck and prosperity.
